title.zh: 行星能量平衡与有效温度
title.en: Planetary energy balance and effective temperature

description.zh: 吸收的阳光 S(1−α)/4 要等于放出的红外 σT⁴；没有大气的地球会停在约 255 K，比观测的 288 K 冷 33 K。
description.en: Absorbed sunlight S(1−α)/4 must equal emitted infrared σT⁴; an airless Earth would settle near 255 K, 33 K colder than the observed 288 K.

en: how cold would Earth be without air

title.zh: 温室效应：一层只挡红外的大气

description.zh: 空气层让阳光通过、吸收地面红外并向下退回一半，地面要放出更多热才能平衡；吸收比例 0.76 时地面正好 288 K。
description.en: A layer that passes sunlight but absorbs ground infrared sends half back down, so the ground must run warmer; absorbing 76 % gives exactly 288 K.

zh: 为什么有大气地球更暖
en: why does an atmosphere warm the surface

title.zh: 排放高度：越高越冷，从高处散热
title.en: Emission height: cooler air higher up radiates to space

description.zh: 地球向太空散热的地方在高空，高空总是那个约 255 K；加厚大气把排放层抬高，下面就要更暖。
description.en: Earth sheds heat from high in the air, which always sits near 255 K; a thicker atmosphere lifts that level, and everything below must warm.

zh: 加二氧化碳为什么变暖
en: why is it colder higher up
why does more CO2 warm the surface

description.zh: 15 微米吸收带的中心早已不透明，但两侧的坡随浓度变黑，所以每翻一倍挡住的红外差不多一样多：约 3.7–4.7 W/m²。
description.en: The centre of the 15 µm band is long opaque, but its sloping wings keep darkening, so every doubling blocks about the same amount: roughly 3.7–4.7 W/m².

zh: 二氧化碳不是已经饱和了吗

title.en: Climate feedbacks: one degree becomes three

description.zh: 加倍二氧化碳本身只带来约 1.2 K；水汽、冰雪和云把升温一轮一轮放大，合起来到约 3.4 K。
description.en: Doubling CO₂ alone gives about 1.2 K; water vapour, ice and clouds amplify it round by round to about 3.4 K.

title.zh: 为什么敏感度的区间这么宽
title.en: Why the climate sensitivity range is so wide

description.zh: 敏感度 = 无反馈升温 ÷ (1 − f)。f 的不确定是对称的，除出来的敏感度却拖着一条长长的高尾巴。
description.en: Sensitivity = no-feedback warming ÷ (1 − f). A symmetric uncertainty in f becomes a long high tail in sensitivity.

zh: 为什么预测范围这么大
en: why is the range so wide

title.zh: 海洋的拖延与时间常数
title.en: Ocean lag and the time constant

description.zh: 海洋像一锅需要慢慢烧开的水：二氧化碳加倍那年只走完一部分升温，剩下的要几十到几百年，取决于参与的水有多深。
description.en: The ocean is a slow pot to heat: when CO₂ has doubled only part of the warming has arrived, and the rest takes decades to centuries depending on how deep the mixed water goes.

zh: 为什么停止排放还会变暖

reason.zh: 第 2 章在第 1 章的有效温度 Te = 255 K 上加一层只挡红外的大气：地面温度 Te(2/(2−ε))^¼，ε = 0.76 时到 288 K。
reason.en: Chapter 2 adds one infrared-absorbing layer on top of chapter 1’s effective temperature Te = 255 K: the surface reaches Te(2/(2−ε))^¼, 288 K at ε = 0.76.

reason.zh: 第 3 章把第 2 章的一层换成 N 层黑体：地面 Te(N+1)^¼，最上层总是 Te，于是变暖取决于向太空散热的那一层有多高、多冷。
reason.en: Chapter 3 replaces chapter 2’s single layer with N black layers: the surface is Te(N+1)^¼ and the top layer is always Te, so warming depends on how high and cold the layer radiating to space is.

reason.zh: 第 4 章的吸收带模型在第 3 章的标准大气温度廓线上积分：吸收带中心早已“饱和”，变化发生在两翼从更高、更冷处散热的地方。
reason.en: Chapter 4’s band model integrates over chapter 3’s standard-atmosphere temperature profile: the band centre is long “saturated”, and the change happens in the wings, which now radiate from higher, colder air.

reason.zh: 第 6 章把第 5 章的反馈系数 f 当作不确定量：敏感度是 1/(1−f) 的形状，f 的对称误差变成 2.17–7.74 K 这样向高处拖长的区间。
reason.en: Chapter 6 treats chapter 5’s feedback factor f as uncertain: sensitivity goes as 1/(1−f), so a symmetric error in f becomes a range like 2.17–7.74 K with a long high tail.

reason.zh: 第 1 章的平衡用到“散热随温度的四次方增长”，这一点在黑体辐射页可以单独看。
reason.en: Chapter 1’s balance rests on emission growing as the fourth power of temperature, which the Blackbody Radiation page shows on its own.

reason.zh: 第 1 章把整个地球当作一个温度；不同纬度、不同季节收到多少阳光，见“气候能量账本”。
reason.en: Chapter 1 gives the whole Earth one temperature; how much sunlight each latitude and season receives is on the Climate Energy Ledger page.

reason.zh: 第 4 章的强迫随浓度取对数：ΔF = 5.35 ln(C/C₀)，每翻一倍增加同样多（3.71 W/m²）；对数本身见“指数与对数”。
reason.en: Chapter 4’s forcing is logarithmic in concentration, ΔF = 5.35 ln(C/C₀), the same 3.71 W/m² for each doubling; the logarithm itself is on Exponentials & Logarithms.

reason.zh: 第 5 章用 AR6 的反馈中值得到 3.39 K；“气候反馈”页可以把这些反馈一项一项打开或关掉。
reason.en: Chapter 5 gets 3.39 K from AR6’s central feedback values; the Climate Feedback page switches them on and off one at a time.

label.zh: 浓度不变 ≠ 停止排放
label.en: Fixed concentration is not zero emissions

reason.zh: 第 7 章把二氧化碳浓度固定不动；停止排放后海洋和陆地继续吸收，浓度会慢慢下降，见“碳循环”。
reason.en: Chapter 7 holds the CO₂ concentration fixed; after emissions stop the ocean and land keep taking it up and concentrations slowly fall, see The Carbon Cycle.
